title: Mother faking telepathy on Danny Jones's show

tellings.quote: It's unfortunate that some of them like this woman that went on Danny Jones, I think are actually faking things. The mother of one of the kids and she clearly was peeking past this blindfold

plain: A mother of one of the children featured in The Telepathy Tapes, a series about children said to read minds, went on Danny Jones's podcast and, Michels says, was clearly peeking past her blindfold. Michels tells this himself, saying he thinks some of those involved are faking it, which he calls unfortunate for the wider claim.
